description: Phoenix Sky Harbor Daily Temps is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. Max and min daily temp recorded at Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport in °F. Data sourced from Science & Operations Officer, NOAA/NWS Phoenix, AZ. Aggregated data for sub-state, state, regional, and national level monthly temperature and precipitation data can be obtained from the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) at:. Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Environmental and Sustainability. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: National Weather Service - Phoenix Office. The portal shows 2024-03-14 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
